edits.old: The real lot and account records are loaded by P1's own cutover migration on its own Flyway sequence (DP-15), and the reconciliation that produces the breaks is RWB-P1-DM009-APP's.
edits.new: The real lot and account rows are loaded by rwb-debtsale on its own Flyway sequence (DP-15), from the records that RWB-P1-DM009-APP extracts and maps, and the reconciliation that produces the breaks is RWB-P1-DM009-APP's. RWB-P1-DM009-APP reads v_ace_account and v_ace_payment and writes no other service's schema. The cutover extract is read once through the cutover run from the legacy dump and lands nothing in rwb_source_data; one package per cutover business date goes to rwb-debtsale; the ten clean days are counted from the reconciliation_result rows of the migrated records, and the count and the sign-off are held in the cutover record of the release pipeline. The package layout, the cutover record format and the evidence location are agreed at the cutover rehearsal and recorded in the cutover procedure. The field list beyond the AC1 wording and the legacy dump layout, file name and read identity are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0538; GAP-2173).

Its states are loading and breaks, as the legacy story names them; its empty, error and no access states are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1034).

edits.old: What the wave entry check looks at instead is the run report, whose environment, layout and retention are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0449; ASM-0641).
edits.new: The wave 4 entry check agrees the harness pack: the SIT environment and base hosts per hop; a cutover extract fixture with lot LOT-SYN-0009, its two account links with the orphan ACC-SYN-000917, and source and migrated_at; a reconciliation extract with one row per orphan and its reason; one run report per business date; a retention that matches the wave evidence; and a gate that fails on any unresolved key, any stored balance or payment, or a suppressed break. The environment, the base hosts, the data seeding set and the retention period are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0449; ASM-0641).
